request.style: English, warm female solo voice, upright bass, piano, brushed snare, muted trumpet, soft mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Deep down my soul is calling out
To you who sit above the clouds
My heart is waiting on your word
In all the dark and heavy furor

[Chorus]
With the Lord there is steadfast love
And abundant redemption flows
He will redeem us from our sins
This is where the mercy ends

[Verse]
I put my hope in what you say
My soul waits more than watchmen stay
They wait for morning breaking light
I wait for you through day and night

[Chorus]
With the Lord there is steadfast love
And abundant redemption flows
He will redeem us from our sins
This is where the mercy ends

[Bridge]
Forgiveness rests within your hands
So we may fear you as we stand
Not in dread but holy awe
Your truth will never fail or waver

[Outro]
Israel, hope in the Lord
With him is love, a living word
